title: System Data Engineer (PNA & E-CAT)
description:
**About APTIV**
APTIV is a global technology company that develops safer, greener and more connected solutions, which enable the future of mobility. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, Aptiv has 160,000 employees and operates 14 technical centers, as well as manufacturing sites and customer support centers, in 44 countries. Visit aptiv.com
  
  
Today, our mission is to shape the world with more safer, greener and more connected solutions that's changing the world. We are dedicated to bring the next generation of autonomous vehicles, smart cities and connectivity to life.
  
  
Aptiv Connection Systems, Chennai Engineering Center in Chennai, India established in 2001 catering complete product development solutions right from concept design till validation testing to global OEMs. Located in Chennai city, the southern part of India which is known as automotive hub of India.
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY**
:
  
  
To support the Part Number Assignment (PNA) activities, E-catalog & Web inquiries.
  
  
**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES TO BE ACCOMPLISHED:**

* Analyze and verify Part Number Allocation (PNA) requests.
* Collect required technical information and allocate part numbers according to the request.
* Classify and standardize component and product data in the system.
* Communicate with suppliers and follow up to obtain required product information.
* Prepare, review, and verify product drawings for accuracy and completeness.
* Monitor and maintain BOMs, product attributes, and technical data in line with the latest drawing revisions.
* Complete and close assigned requests within established deadlines.
* Manage and maintain Product Information Management (PIM) data for the online catalog.
* Handle online product inquiries and provide appropriate technical/product information to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement of product data quality, standardization, and catalog processes.

**EDUCATION**

* B.SC / Diploma / bachelor's in mechanical / Automobile Engineering streams.

**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in data processing, conversion and migration activities with knowledge in product design from the connector / automotive background.

**SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED:**

* Good product knowledge.
* Good drawing reading skills.
* Good knowledge in database structure (PDM exposure).
* Good skills in data collection and processing.
* Good skills in MS- Office functions.
* Excellent English communication skills.

**PERSONALITY TRAITS:**

* Time management.
* Planning and Co-ordination.
* Communication skills to interact globally.
* Accountability and self-initiative.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Solution Integrator
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
Ericsson is looking for a highly motivated Senior Solution Integrator with 4–5 years of experience in Telecom BSS (Order Care/EOC, Billing, and Charging) and a strong background in large-scale data migration and transformation programs. In this role, you will drive end-to-end data migration initiatives, design scalable integration solutions, and leverage modern cloud and AI technologies to enable seamless telecom transformations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Design, execute, and validate end-to-end data migration activities, including ETL, data modeling, data validation, benchmarking, and capacity planning.
  
  
Develop scalable migration and integration solutions using RDBMS, API-led architectures, and microservices.
  
  
Collaborate across OSS/BSS ecosystems and enterprise platforms to ensure successful data transformation and migration.
  
  
Optimize performance for high-volume data processing environments and migration workloads.
  
  
Leverage AI-driven capabilities for automation, analytics, and AIOps use cases.
  
  
Ensure data quality, integrity, consistency, and compliance throughout the migration lifecycle.
  
  
Participate in solution design reviews, technical assessments, and deployment planning.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
4–5 years of experience in Telecom BSS domains, including Order Care (EOC), Billing, and Charging.
  
  
Strong expertise in Oracle Database, SQL, and PL/SQL; performance tuning experience is an advantage.
  
  
Working knowledge of Python, Java, Shell Scripting, and XML.
  
  
Strong understanding of data migration methodologies, ETL frameworks, data transformation, and reconciliation processes.
  
  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
  
  
Hands-on experience applying AI technologies for automation, analytics, AIOps, and AI service integration.
  
  
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and source control tools such as Git/SVN.
  
  
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in telecom transformation, modernization, or digital migration programs.
  
  
Exposure to distributed systems, microservices, and API-driven integrations.
  
  
Knowledge of OSS/BSS data models, telecom business processes, and enterprise integration patterns.
  
  
Experience supporting large-scale production environments and mission-critical deployments.

title: Sr. Consultant - Data Engineering
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
At TransUnion, we are committed to using information for good. We foster an environment where innovation, professional growth, and collaboration drive meaningful outcomes for our customers and communities. As part of our Fraud Prevention organization, you will work with talented data scientists, engineers, product leaders, and fraud experts to build and scale data platforms that support advanced fraud analytics, machine learning, and real-time decisioning solutions.
  
  
You will work alongside data scientists, fraud strategists, software engineers, and product leaders to develop high-performance data environments that power some of the industry's leading fraud prevention capabilities. This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
Impact You'll Make
  
  
As a Data Engineer supporting Fraud Solutions, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data pipelines, data products, and analytical platforms that enable fraud detection, monitoring, and investigation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead the global technical development, deployment, and maintenance of Cyber Defense data ecosystem, using the latest data programming languages and visualization tools. This includes optimizing ‘big data’ data pipelines, architectures and data sets to enhance anomaly detection tools
* Design, build, and optimize scalable batch and real-time data pipelines supporting fraud detection and risk analytics.
* Partner with Data Scientists to operationalize fraud models and analytical solutions in production environments.
* Build and manage ETL/ELT workflows for ingestion and transformation of structured and unstructured data.
* Design, develop and publish charts and dashboards for alerts on potential fraud and regulatory violations
* Ensure data quality, governance, lineage, observability, and monitoring across fraud data ecosystems.
* Develop reusable frameworks and automation tools that accelerate fraud analytics and model deployment.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, cybersecurity, and fraud teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Support streaming architectures that enable near real-time fraud detection and decisioning.
* Optimize platform performance, reliability, and cost efficiency across cloud environments.
* Troubleshoot complex data and pipeline issues while ensuring high availability and operational excellence.
* Document architecture, technical standards, and engineering best practices.
* Design and implement solutions to automate department tools and technology to drive more efficiency and productivity

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 2 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or large-scale data platform development.
* Demonstrated expertise in performing data engineering work within Google Cloud ecosystem (GCP), designing and developing dashboards in visualization tools.
* Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and technologies
* Strong SQL expertise and advanced proficiency in Python or Scala.
* Experience designing and maintaining enterprise-scale ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark/PySpark.
* Experience working with large-scale datasets and cloud-native data platforms.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, dimensional modeling, and advanced database concepts.
* Experience implementing data quality controls, reconciliation processes, and monitoring frameworks.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices including CI/CD, automated testing, source control, and DevOps principles.
* Understanding of the business intelligence development life cycle including the ability to lead collaboration discussions to gather the needs for desired outcomes for the BI solutions being built
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Workforce for Good**
, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.
  
  
Be a part of our
**Workforce for Good**
– you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

title: SENIOR CONSULTANT
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary**
Migrate existing Lambda/Dagster/dbt pipelines onto a Glue‑based, Redshift‑centric medallion architecture (S3 Bronze → Redshift Silver → Gold canonical model), embed data quality, lineage, security and CI/CD controls into every pipeline, and mentor engineers through domain‑by‑domain migration waves
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
* Design and build Glue‑based ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
* Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
* Build automated data‑quality gates, reconciliation checks, and source‑to‑report lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of business‑critical reports
* Implement IAM, AWS‑native encryption, Secrets Manager and Gold‑layer RBAC/least‑privilege access.
* Establish Dev/Test environments, Git‑based CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
* Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
* Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
* Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
* Amazon Redshift (deep) data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
* AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and hands‑on medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
* AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Python (primary) — PySpark for Glue jobs.
* MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
* DBT— must be able to read, reverse‑engineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
* Data‑quality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
* Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

**Nice to have**

* Dagster orchestration — for AS‑IS discovery and migration.
* Kafka / event‑driven streaming ingestion.
* Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
* Tableau, Metabase serving‑layer knowledge.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Data‑governance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).
* UK financial‑services experience IFRS 9, BCBS 239, FCA/PRA reporting, UK GDPR.
* Preparing governed datasets for AI/ML use cases.

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.
  
  
Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.
  
  
**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

title: Unix Scripting Specialist Officer
description:
The Reconciliation Developer – Officer (C11) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for developing, configuring, testing, and supporting data reconciliations and automated data controls.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior technical leads, the developer focuses on implementing matching rules, maintaining data feeds, resolving technical breaks, and executing scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests across financial systems and data distribution pipelines.
  
  
**Hybrid Schedule:**
2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.
  
  
**Reconciliation Rule Build:**
Configure, test, and maintain multi-way matching rules, tolerance checks, and automated exception routing on enterprise reconciliation platforms (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or internal reconciliation engines).
  
  
**Break Analysis & Triage:**
Investigate reconciliation breaks and discrepancies, identify root causes in data transformations, and apply rule adjustments or fixes.
  
  
**Data Processing & Scripting:**
Write and optimize Python scripts and SQL queries to extract, transform, and load transactional and ledger data into reconciliation engines.
  
  
**Requirements Implementation:**
Review Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and technical specifications to implement mapping rules, data schemas, and validation checks.
  
  
**Data Feed Maintenance**
: Monitor daily reconciliation runs, batch feeds, and automated jobs, ensuring successful data ingestion from upstream systems.
  
  
**Assisting Backlog Remediation:**
Actively deliver user stories and tasks to address the operational backlog of scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests.
  
  
**Testing & Deployment Support:**
Perform unit testing, assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and prepare deployment artifacts using Git and CI/CD pipelines
  
  
**Team Participation:**
Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and backlog refinement sessions within an Agile framework.
  
  
Operational Collaboration: Work closely with operations users, business analysts, and quality assurance testers to clarify requirements and resolve defect tickets.
  
  
**Technology Adoption:**
Learn and apply emerging tools and automation techniques, including data processing utilities (e.g., PySpark, Airflow) and automated anomaly detection workflows.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
* 4-8 years of hands-on software development, data manipulation, or reconciliation configuration experience in Financial Services or IT.
* Solid foundation as a technical individual contributor executing assigned tasks with quality.
* Python: Practical experience with data manipulation (pandas, numpy), data parsing, and scripting.
* SQL: Strong proficiency in writing queries, joins, aggregations, subqueries, and working with relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, etc.).
* Basic Understanding: Familiarity with Java, Scala, or C# is a plus.
* Working knowledge of batch data processing (e.g., Apache Spark/PySpark basics).
* Familiarity with scheduled workflow tools (e.g., Apache Airflow) and messaging/event concepts (e.g., Kafka).
* Exposure to cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, or GCP) is advantageous.

title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
13
  
  
We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as
**Director of Engineering, Data Platforms**
for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls.
  
  
This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders.
  
  
You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with
**NeoXam DataHub**
is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle—from acquisition through distribution—to create a trusted single source of truth.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform.
* Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns.
* Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support.
* Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services.
* Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms.

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement
  
  

* Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner.
* Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
* Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform.
* Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction.
* Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering.

Data Mastering Platform Integration
  
  

* Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
* Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
* Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows.
* Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data.
* Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management.

Team Leadership and Delivery Management
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering.
* Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability.
* Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members.
* Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership.
* Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms.

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards
  
  

* Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations.
* Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access.
* Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness.
* Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate.
* Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant.

**Required Qualifications**
Leadership and Delivery Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment.
* Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
* Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture.
* Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services.
* Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts.
* Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows.
* Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines.
* Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering.
* Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring.
* Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards.

Collaboration and Execution
  
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams.
* Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans.
* Comfortable operating in a role that blends technical leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery oversight.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains or asset types.
* Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging or metadata management environments, including integrations involving operational and business metadata platforms.
* Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, or golden record workflows in financial services environments.
* Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets.
* Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
* Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, and auditability requirements are important.
* Databricks certifications, AWS certifications (such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus. AWS certification paths remain relevant for modern cloud-native data engineering roles.

title: IT Analyst Applications (Visualization & Power Platform)
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an experienced
**IT Analyst applications (Visualization & Power Platform)**
to join our
**India GCC – GCIO BI Services - CAT IT Division.**
**The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN / Chennai - WTC**
**This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.**
**Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST**
****Job Description:****
**Role focus:**
Hands-on delivery across Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL, and AI-enabled business solutions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The IT Analyst will design, develop, enhance, and support business applications, dashboards, reporting solutions, and workflow automations for the Visualization team. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI, supported by solid Snowflake and SQL capabilities. The successful candidate will work directly with business partners and technical teams to translate requirements into secure, scalable, user-friendly, and data-driven solutions. The role will also contribute to practical AI-enabled capabilities that improve productivity, analytics, and business decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support Power Apps solutions, including Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps.
* Develop workflow automation and system integration using Power Automate.
* Build and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, scorecards, and operational analytics.
* Develop efficient DAX measures and Power Query transformations and optimize report performance and usability.
* Use Snowflake and SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze data for applications and visualization solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and deliver fit-for-purpose outcomes.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, APIs, Snowflake, and other approved enterprise data sources.
* Apply security, access control, row-level security, data privacy, governance, and application lifecycle management practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Create clear technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer and user support.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, Copilot, and automation to improve business processes and analytical experiences.
* Participate in Agile delivery, estimation, testing, release management, and continuous improvement activities.

Required Technical Competencies
  
  
Microsoft Power Platform
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Power Apps, particularly Canvas Apps. Experience with Model-Driven Apps is desirable.
* Strong hands-on experience with Power Automate, including approvals, notifications, scheduled flows, and integrations.
* Working knowledge of Dataverse, solution packaging, environment management, connectors, and application lifecycle management.
* Ability to design intuitive user experiences and reusable application components.

Power BI and Visualization
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
* Proficiency in data modeling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, drill-throughs, bookmarks, and report navigation.
* Experience performance optimization, refreshing troubleshooting, gateway concepts, and row-level security.
* Ability to apply visualization best practices and translate complex data into clear business insights.

Snowflake and SQL
  
  

* Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, common table expressions, aggregations, views, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience querying and validating data in Snowflake.
* Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Understanding generative AI concepts and practical enterprise use cases.
* Experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex, AI Builder, or AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities.
* Ability to incorporate AI-assisted features into apps, automation, and analytics solutions where appropriate.
* Knowledge of prompt design, responsible AI, data security, privacy, and human validation of AI-generated outputs.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Masters`s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Approximately 5 -7 years of relevant experience in Power Platform, business intelligence, visualization, analytics, or application development.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery experience in Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, SQL, and Snowflake.
* Experience gathering requirements and delivering solutions in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience supporting production applications, dashboards, and data solutions in an enterprise environment.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, REST APIs, SharePoint Online, or Teams integration.
* Exposure to Tableau or ThoughtSpot.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable work management and CI/CD tool.
* Understanding testing practices, source control, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and support processes.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with global stakeholders.
* Experience in machine manufacturing or a related industrial domain is preferred.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to understand business needs and recommend practical solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Power Platform, analytics, AI, and data technologies.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Core Application Systems:**
Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

**Application Design, Architecture:**
Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

**Requirements Analysis:**
Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
* Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
* Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
* Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
* Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

**System and Technology Integration:**
Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

**System Testing:**
Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
****Level Working Knowledge:****

* Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
* Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
* Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
* Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.
* Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures.

****Posting Dates:****

Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

title: Data Engineer, Data 360 - Salesforce Practice - 5+ years - immediate joiners only
description:
About the role

This is a Data 360 platform engineering role. You build the data foundation the program's marketing and AI work depends on — ingestion, modeling, identity and activation — including headless use of Data 360 by other systems and agents. Perficient's Salesforce practice delivers in small, AI-first teams. AI drafts most of what used to be written by hand — requirements, stories, configuration, tests and documentation — and a named person reviews, corrects and approves every piece of it, and is accountable for it. We hire people who can direct that work, defend it in front of a client, and keep learning as the tools change.

**About the engagement**

You will join a long-term, AI-first Salesforce program for a Fortune 50 global automotive manufacturer, as part of a delivery team that spans India and the US. The program runs across Salesforce Core, Marketing Cloud, Data 360 and Agentforce, and the work moves between them. We are hiring people who learn new systems quickly and go where the work is — on a long engagement that matters as much as what you know today.

**What you'll do**

▪ Build data streams and map source data to the Data 360 data model.

▪ Configure identity resolution and validate the unified profiles it produces.

▪ Build calculated insights, segments and activations, and verify the populations they return.

▪ Expose Data 360 to other systems and to AI agents through APIs and data graphs — the headless pattern.

▪ Reconcile data both ways against the source, and spot-check records by hand.

▪ Keep consumption cost visible: ingestion volume, refresh frequency and processing drive what the design costs to run.

**How you'll use AI**

▪ Generate mappings, transformation logic and validation queries with AI, and read every query before trusting the number it returns.

▪ Use AI to profile source data quickly — and check what it summarizes against the data itself.

▪ Review generated work critically before it moves. Generated work fails plausibly — complete, well-formed, internally consistent and wrong — and you are the one who catches it.

▪ Answer one question about anything you approve: what did you change or correct before you approved it? A reviewer who never has an answer is not reviewing.

▪ Work fluently in whatever the engagement runs on — Claude, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, platform assistants, or the client's own stack. The activity is mandatory; the tool usually is not.

**Qualifications**

Required

▪ 4–6 years of relevant experience, including client-facing consulting

▪ Data 360 (Data Cloud) implementation — data streams, data model mapping, identity resolution and segmentation

▪ Data modeling and SQL

▪ Data Cloud Consultant certification

▪ Demonstrated, current use of AI tools in delivery work

▪ Strong written and spoken communication, and the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred

▪ Experience with external data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks

▪ Marketing Cloud activation experience

▪ Salesforce Platform Administrator certification

Who we're looking for

Technical depth gets you in the door. Beyond that, we hire for four qualities together, not any one in isolation — and we want people who are humble enough to teach as readily as they learn, hungry enough to close a gap without being asked, and smart about people as well as platforms.

▪ Techno-functional depth — You understand the business process behind the story well enough to notice when a technically correct build solves the wrong problem. On this program: the client expects excellence in every discipline. Pair technical depth with data-driven reasoning — know your solution, know the evidence behind it, and be ready to defend both.

▪ Client presence — You lead demos and UAT sessions, and you can hold a technical conversation with a client in support of the architect. On this program: the client values radical transparency and accountability without fear. Being in the room means saying the hard thing early, on camera or in person.

▪ AI-native delivery — Generation is your first move, and you can show where you overrode what the tool produced. On this program: the client reviews performance metrics consistently. AI-native delivery here means measurable, defensible output, not only speed.

▪ Learn-fast orientation — You have picked up a new cloud, language or tool on a live engagement and been productive in it quickly. On this program: raise what you don't know immediately, not after two weeks of pretending otherwise. Gaps surfaced early are welcome; gaps hidden are not.

You are already using AI tools to work faster and deliver better outcomes, and you want to keep pushing on that. This is where the practice is headed, so it is a practical, non-negotiable skill, not a nice-to-have.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Director – Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce
description:
**Director - Cell Therapy IT, Software Engineering - Salesforce**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to build the digital backbone that delivers next‑generation cell therapies to patients at scale?In this role, you will build and deliver the software platforms that power end‑to‑end activities related to cell therapy across development, manufacturing, and supply. Your work will directly influence how quickly and safely therapies move from treatment sites to manufacturing lines and back to patients.
  
  
You will lead a global engineering organization to compose, build, and industrialize enterprise-grade systems—spanning a Cell Orchestration platform built on Salesforce, AWS- services, and agentic AI automation. Partnering closely with operational and technology leaders, you will define a modern, scalable stack and translate strategy into robust, compliant solutions that drive speed, quality, and reliability. Based in Chennai, India, you will be at the center of a high-impact mission with global reach. How will you scale intelligent automation to orchestrate one of the most complex supply chains in healthcare?
  
  

* Accountabilities:
* Technology Planning and Architecture: Define and evolve a scalable technology strategy and reference architecture that underpins cell therapy operations from vein-to-vein, aligning platform choices with business outcomes.
* Platform Leadership: Lead the build and delivery of the Salesforce-based cellular coordination system, ensuring it is robust, scalable, secure, and fit for regulated environments.
* SDLC Ownership and DevSecOps: Own end-to-end software delivery from design to deployment and support, embedding DevSecOps, automation, and built-in quality to accelerate releases and reduce risk.
* Integration and Interoperability: Orchestrate integrations across Salesforce Service & Life Sciences -Cloud, MuleSoft, mobile-first apps, AWS services, and event streaming (e.g., Kafka) to enable seamless data and workflow continuity.
* Regulatory and Compliance Readiness: Bake compliance into every phase (GxP, HIPAA, FDA, GDPR), establishing traceability, validation, and auditability without slowing down delivery.
* Agentic AI Development or similar Automation experience is essential. Support advancing agentic AI to build autonomous software agents. They complete complex operational tasks and make decisions safely and at scale.
* Technical Roadmap: Life Sciences Cloud: Guide the industrialization of Agent-force Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and the Advanced Therapy Module to enable next-generation cell therapy delivery.
* Engineering Excellence and GenAI-Enabled SDLC: Establish best- practices for full-stack engineering and leverage GenAI for code generation, testing, and SDLC automation to boost productivity and quality.
* Talent Leadership and Culture: Build and mentor a high-performing global-team of engineers and solution architects, cultivating innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Vendor and Partner Management: Manage external partners to deliver quality, secure, and compliant solutions, optimizing for value and speed.
* Innovation and Future-Readiness: Stay ahead of LLMs, autonomous agents, and cloud-native advances; translate emerging tech into practical upgrades that modernize systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Bachelor's - degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of software development experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role within life sciences, biotech, or manufacturing IT environments.
* Experience managing sophisticated Salesforce environments and multi-cloud implementations.
* Experience in leading multiple Product Development teams globally with engineering and delivery ownership
* Experience building and deploying software solutions in regulated environments (GxP , HIPAA, FDA).
* Expertise in modern development tools and platforms: AWS, Azure, Python, Salesforce (Service Cloud and Life Sciences), MuleSoft, Confluent / Kafka.
* Expertise delivering digital solutions across patient engagement, R&D, and product commercialization.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, Platform Developer II).
* Familiarity with AI/ML features within Salesforce ecosystem (Einstein, predictive analytics).
* Understanding of GenAI use cases in software development and automated testing.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI tools and frameworks
* Solid background in system architecture, secure coding practices, and cloud-native design.
* Why AstraZeneca:

Join a purpose-led team where advanced technology meets scientific ambition to change what’s possible for patients. Here, unexpected teams—engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders—get in the same room to tackle problems that matter, with the investment and freedom to experiment through hackathons, prototypes, and scaled delivery. You will help build the digital capabilities that accelerate medicines to those who need them, supported by a collaborative culture that values kindness alongside ambition, rigorous standards alongside creativity, and continuous learning at every step.
  
  
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
We're seeking an exceptional Data Platform Engineer to shape the strategic direction and architecture of our data infrastructure. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll co-own the overall platform architecture, set technical standards across the entire Data Engineering organization, and drive initiatives that directly impact our data strategy. You'll be a force multiplier—inspiring teams, mentoring senior engineers, and making architectural decisions that affect how the entire organization builds and operates data systems. We are in the midst of transforming our legacy infrastructure into a modern cloud-first platform, and you'll be instrumental in leading this technical evolution.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Strategic Platform Leadership
  
  

* Co-own and evolve the overall data platform architecture across all domains
* Guide the technical vision for the entire Data Engineering organization
* Drive platform initiatives that directly support the company's data strategy
* Lead the modernization of legacy systems while ensuring business continuity
* Identify and solve problems that span the entire Data Engineering org before they impact delivery
* Set the bar for excellence and serve as an inspiration across all engineering teams

Architecture & Technical Excellence
  
  

* Design and drive implementation of highly scalable platform architectures for multi-TB+ daily workloads
* Author and sign off on all RFCs and technical specifications that touch your domain(s)
* Define best practices and patterns that become standard across the organization
* Build self-service infrastructure that empowers hundreds of data consumers while maintaining reliability
* Design event-driven, real-time data architectures using Kafka and stream processing at scale
* Contribute to any codebase across the organization, setting quality standards through exemplary code

Platform Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Architect comprehensive Infrastructure as Code strategies and GitOps frameworks
* Design enterprise-grade security frameworks including encryption, zero-trust access controls, and compliance
* Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical platform services and drive observability strategy
* Lead complex incident response, conduct thorough post-mortems, and implement systemic improvements
* Drive platform reliability and performance optimization initiatives

Influence & Enablement
  
  

* Mentor IC9 and IC10 engineers, accelerating their technical growth and impact
* Collaborate across the entire Engineering organization as a thought partner
* Interact with executives and external stakeholders as a domain expert
* Democratize data access by empowering more teams to contribute to the data stack safely
* Identify hiring gaps and help define interview panels for critical technical roles
* Actively participate in and contribute to Data Engineering communities (conferences, Stack Overflow, vendor forums)

What You Bring
  
  
Deep Technical Expertise
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, and at least one additional programming language
* Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented design and software engineering principles
* Deep expertise with databases across paradigms: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB
* Extensive Kafka ecosystem expertise: cluster management, Debezium, schema registry, Connect frameworks, stream processing
* Advanced container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker at scale
* Expert knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and cloud-native architectures

Platform Engineering Mastery
  
  

* Proven track record architecting platforms processing multi-TB daily workloads
* Experience designing and operating systems supporting hundreds of concurrent users
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architectures, and scalability patterns
* Expert-level experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger)
* Mastery of data orchestration platforms like Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
* Demonstrated success modernizing legacy data systems while ensuring zero business disruption

Experience & Background
  
  

* 10-15+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering or related field
* Track record of leading complex, org-wide technical initiatives
* History of driving architectural decisions that scale across large organizations
* Experience in high-growth or large enterprise environments
* Deep expertise with both modern and legacy technologies (Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects)

Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and domains
* Excellence in mentoring senior engineers and accelerating their growth
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to all levels
* Comfortable operating in high ambiguity and defining problems before solving them
* Track record of building collaborative relationships across engineering and business organizations
* Recognition as a thought leader in the Data Engineering community

Bonus Points
  
  

* Deep experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Looker, etc.)
* Machine learning infrastructure and MLOps architecture expertise
* Contributions to open-source data infrastructure projects
* Published technical articles, conference talks, or thought leadership in data platforms
* Expert knowledge of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and implementation at scale

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**First 90 Days:**
Understand our architecture deeply, identify systemic opportunities and risks, and begin influencing key technical decisions. Establish yourself as a go-to expert in your domain(s).
  
  
**First Year:**
Drive at least one major architectural initiative that impacts the entire Data Engineering organization. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to leadership and a mentor to senior engineers. Author multiple RFCs that set new standards.
  
  
**Ongoing:**
Continuously shape the technical direction of the organization, mentor the next generation of technical leaders, and maintain your position as one of the most knowledgeable experts in your domain(s) both internally and in the broader Data Engineering community.
  
  
Our Tech Stack
  
  
**Cloud & Infrastructure:**
AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, extensive cloud-native services)
  
  
**Data Technologies:**
Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, SQLMESH, Snowflake, dbt
  
  
**Languages & Frameworks:**
Python, SQL, Java, Scala, Docker, Kubernetes
  
  
**Monitoring & Observability:**
Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog, ELK Stack, Jaeger
  
  
**Legacy Technologies:**
Apache Spark, Oracle, Postgres, SqlServer, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*
